nodes.norm_label: animated title background (rays, fog, portal, embers, wisps, fractal trees)

nodes.label: Guest login (nickname modal)
nodes.rationale: Guest play needs only a nickname (max 20 chars); profile marked isGuest via window.tqGuest; both guest and login paths land in characterSelect.

nodes.label: Returning player resume (Enter as / Log out)
nodes.norm_label: returning player resume (enter as / log out)
nodes.rationale: Decided SYNCHRONOUSLY before the heavy async game boot to avoid login buttons flashing then jumping (the 'weird/laggy login'); reads tamers_quest_save profile from localStorage; ephemeral sessions need sessionStorage tq_session_alive.

nodes.label: Scale-to-fit stage wrapper
nodes.rationale: Stage keeps natural design proportions and is uniformly scaled by JS so composition is identical on any resolution/aspect — no clipping on short screens, no enlarging past design caps.

nodes.label: Stay signed in (remember-me) toggle
nodes.rationale: Persisted under localStorage key tq_stay_signed_in so it survives the OAuth redirect round-trip; shared by all three login methods.

nodes.label: Admin token (x-admin-token header, tq_admin_token localStorage)
nodes.rationale: TQ-105: token persisted in localStorage so admins stay logged in across reloads; load() validates via /api/admin/config and falls back to login on 401; 503 means ADMIN_TOKEN not set on server.

nodes.label: Collapsible admin sections (TQ-222) + Collapse all
nodes.rationale: Per-section collapsed state persists in localStorage (tq-admin-collapsed), keyed by header text.

nodes.label: Combat AI config fields (ai_model/combatTemperature/combatMaxTurnDamageFrac/combatJudgeV2/maxTokens/topP)
nodes.rationale: COMBAT_FIELDS = model, combatTemperature, combatMaxTurnDamageFrac, combatJudgeV2 (v2 structured judge is DEFAULT), maxTokens, topP. Model selects are populated from aiconfig modelOptions; a saved custom/legacy model is kept as its own option (TQ-145/361).

nodes.label: Monochrome admin theme (TQ-212)
nodes.rationale: Black/white/grays only; status meaning carried by ●/✓/✗ glyphs, text and brightness (errors = brightest white) rather than hue.

Named keys: combatSystem, combatUser, combatJudgeV2System, combatJudgeV2User, genModelBrief (editable render-target brief, TQ-300), catchJudge*, tileBuilder*, itemBuilder*. TQ-106: every prompt has its own Save (setPrompts merges; blank value resets to server default).

nodes.label: Real-money sales kill-switch (salesEnabled, TQ-198)
nodes.rationale: Default OFF until launch; gates Paddle checkout + buy buttons on the pricing page (pricing.html reads /api/paddle/config which only returns packs when sales are on).

nodes.label: Combat (turn-based: Attack / Catch / Swap / Flee)
nodes.rationale: Capturing is easier when the wild monster is weakened.

nodes.label: Controls (desktop / mobile touch / controller)
nodes.rationale: Desktop WASD + Shift sprint + hold Space to charge throw + [ ] / Q swap chain + Esc pause + M mute; mobile left virtual joystick + drag-to-aim THROW button; controller left stick, A throw, ABXY attacks, LB catch, RB flee, START pause.

nodes.label: Currencies & upgrades (Gold earned / Essence premium, not pay-to-win)
nodes.norm_label: currencies & upgrades (gold earned / essence premium, not pay-to-win)
nodes.rationale: Everything that affects power is bought with gold; Essence is optional, cosmetic/convenience only and never buys an advantage.

nodes.label: Exploring & extracting (biomes, loot chests, closing storm, extraction portals)
nodes.norm_label: exploring & extracting (biomes, loot chests, closing storm, extraction portals)
nodes.rationale: Being outside the safe zone chips at team health; defeat before extracting loses the team brought into the run (the Q10 death penalty).

nodes.label: Spirit chains & capturing
nodes.rationale: Loadout of up to three chains, hot-swappable; throws are free and boomerang back; one chain in flight at a time; hold to charge for range; higher tiers capture tougher monsters; capture charges (durability) are spent on a successful catch, not on a throw.

nodes.label: Cookie & Storage Notice (localStorage keys)
nodes.rationale: No tracking/advertising cookies; strictly-necessary localStorage keys: tq_session_token, tq_muted, tq_onboarded, tq_chain_skin, tq_admin_token (operator-only). Used without a consent banner.

nodes.label: Imprint / Impressum (operator Dominik Burger, Windisch, Switzerland)
nodes.norm_label: imprint / impressum (operator dominik burger, windisch, switzerland)

nodes.label: Privacy Policy
nodes.rationale: Processes nickname, anonymous session token, gameplay profile, transient connection data; no real name/email required for anonymous play; inactive profiles may be removed after 24 months; purchase records up to 10 years (Swiss bookkeeping); not directed at children under 16.

nodes.label: Public leaderboard disclosure
nodes.rationale: Nickname plus extraction and PvP-win counts may be shown to other players.

nodes.label: Purchases & Refund Policy
nodes.rationale: Paddle is Merchant of Record and seller of record; Essence is a digital good delivered instantly; generally non-refundable once credited/spent except where law requires (EU/EEA/Swiss withdrawal right ends on immediate supply with consent); refunds processed by Paddle.

nodes.label: Terms of Service
nodes.rationale: Beta 'as is'; acceptable-use bans cheating/bots/abuse/offensive nicknames; virtual items have no real-world value; AI-generated content may be imperfect; governed by Swiss law.

nodes.label: Third-party processors (OpenAI, Railway, Paddle)
nodes.rationale: OpenAI resolves combat and generates content (in-game context only); Railway hosts app, WS server and DB; Paddle is payment provider and Merchant of Record — operator never sees full card details.

nodes.label: Virtual items policy: no direct sale of gameplay power
nodes.norm_label: virtual items policy: no direct sale of gameplay power
nodes.rationale: Purchased Essence may be spent on cosmetics and optional player-to-player trades (monster marketplace); the game does not directly sell stat advantages; skins remain purely visual.

nodes.label: Essence (premium currency)
nodes.rationale: Optional; spent on cosmetic skins and player-to-player trades such as the monster marketplace; the game never sells gameplay power or stat boosts directly. Prices in USD; local currency/tax at checkout.

nodes.label: Essence packs (Pouch 500/$4.99, Sack 1,100/$9.99 +10%, Chest 2,400/$19.99 +20%, Hoard 6,500/$49.99 +30%)
nodes.rationale: Chest is tagged Most popular; Hoard Best value. data-pack ids: pouch, sack, chest, hoard.

nodes.label: Remove ads one-time purchase (TQ-174, $1.99 default)
nodes.rationale: Hidden until /api/paddle/config returns adFree (sales on AND PADDLE_ADFREE_PRICE_ID set); grants permanent server-side profile.adFree resolved by price ID, never trusting the page.

nodes.label: Subscription (TQ-270: premium battle pass + ad-free, $4.99/month default)
nodes.norm_label: subscription (tq-270: premium battle pass + ad-free, $4.99/month default)
nodes.rationale: Hidden until cfg.sub is provisioned (PADDLE_SUB_PRICE_ID); verified subscription webhook (TQ-269) stamps server-authoritative profile.subscribedUntil.

nodes.label: Player Guide (guide.html, TQ-460)
nodes.rationale: Player-facing how-to-play, served in-app at /guide; self-contained inline CSS, no JS, matches the title palette. The dev/game-logic wiki lives on GitHub.

nodes.label: Legal & Privacy page (legal.html)
nodes.rationale: Last updated 2026-06-13; TQ-383 palette synced to src/ui/theme.js PAL (charcoal + ember accent).

nodes.label: robots.txt (allow /, disallow /admin and /api/)
nodes.rationale: Keeps the token-gated admin panel and JSON/WS API out of search indexes as defense-in-depth and to avoid junk results; sitemap at https://tamersquest.com/sitemap.xml.

nodes.label: Wiki redirect page (archived 2026-06-11 → GitHub Wiki)
nodes.rationale: In-app wiki migrated to the canonical, code-mirrored GitHub Wiki; this page is noindex and meta-refreshes after 3s; historical content lives in git history.

nodes.label: Instanced turn-based combat over the wire (Q1/Q3)
nodes.norm_label: instanced turn-based combat over the wire (q1/q3)
nodes.rationale: Decision Q1: the rest of the world keeps moving while two combatants duel under a combatId; decision Q3: turns AI-resolved (OpenAI) with engine/combat.js as fallback; catch is deterministic; movement locked during a fight.

nodes.label: AI-judged combat with deterministic crash-net
nodes.rationale: Default judge is the structured v2 Fight-Judgement (combatJudgeV2); the deterministic engine is only a transient crash-net so one failed AI call cannot freeze a fight.

nodes.label: SP/MP unify (Phases A-D)
nodes.rationale: User decision 2026-06-09: the SERVER profile is the single source of truth for team/chains/upgrades/currency in BOTH SP and MP — 'only like this singleplayer will also be cheat proof.' localStorage demoted to session token + prefs. Phase A server-first session, Phase C server-resolved SP runs via queueSolo + loss-safe MERGE importProfile, Phase B route management to server-backed scenes, Phase D deleted 8 local SP scenes (~3500 lines).

nodes.label: SP in-process server stub mirroring handleMessage
nodes.norm_label: sp in-process server stub mirroring handlemessage

nodes.label: importProfile loss-safe MERGE migration
nodes.rationale: Gated !migrated; unions local SP + server MP progress, never removes server data, clamps forged localStorage.

nodes.label: SP is server-authoritative (online-first)
nodes.rationale: Per Dominik's call for cheat-proof SP: SP runs as a private instant 1-player server round; side effect is SP needs the server (connecting state if Railway is cold).

nodes.label: Generation schedule panel (TQ-369)
nodes.rationale: Per-asset (biomes/tiles/monsters) {asset}Enabled + {asset}EveryMs with intervals 1h–1 week; independent of round-start backfill; all off by default because each generation costs OpenAI.

nodes.label: Generation trace panel (TQ-331)
nodes.rationale: Shows per-stage model, exact system+user prompts and raw output so a bad generation can be inspected; in-memory, cleared on server restart. Shares renderTraceList with the fight-judge trace.

nodes.label: Round composition & generation panel (TQ-363/364)
nodes.rationale: Fields: biomesPerRound, newBiomesPerRound, biomeRarity, biomeSize, monstersPerBiome, maxNewMonstersPerRound, tilesCollidablePerBiome, tilesNonCollidablePerBiome, roundGenBackfill (TQ-368). Reused biomes = total − new so a round keeps most of the previous map.

nodes.label: Per-monster XP & level curve (TQ-43)
nodes.rationale: Decision TQ-93. Defeat grants 20 + 10*enemyLevel XP to the fighting monsters; catching grants 0 (the catch is the reward). Level L->L+1 costs 100 * 1.15^(L-1); exponential threshold self-balances against run length without a level cap. Level-up refills HP + energy.

nodes.label: PARITY-1 combat resolver unification (aiTurn)
nodes.rationale: One shared resolver aiTurn in server/combat.js owns every turn for SP and MP; SP POSTs /api/combat/turn (gated by GET /api/combat/status) hitting the same buildState+aiTurn path; the per-turn AI<->deterministic flip is gone; PvP routes through aiTurn too.

nodes.label: PARITY-6 parity snapshot tests (identical inputs → identical outputs)
nodes.norm_label: parity-6 parity snapshot tests (identical inputs → identical outputs)
nodes.rationale: src/engine/parity.test.js scripts a full run through shared engine helpers; server/combat.parity.test.js drives the SP HTTP entry (resolveTurnRequest/handleCombatHttp) and MP WS entry (resolveCombatAction) with a mocked judge and asserts byte-identical state.

nodes.label: SP/MP parity — shared-engine contract (PT2-T11)
nodes.rationale: User-greenlit TOP PRIORITY 2026-06-07: SP becomes 'MP against a local-only server stub' so scenes only render + send intents, killing the class of playtest bugs from two drifting codepaths (separate rosters, SP map lagging MP, divergent combat/collision).

nodes.label: No duplicate SP/MP rules
nodes.rationale: Any gameplay rule present in both modes lives in shared engine code and is covered by tests.

nodes.label: Immediate-mode + host-owned scrim
nodes.rationale: Every existing detail view is immediate-mode and hand-gates its overlay (roster inspect, hub openMonsterDetail/overlayOpen), so the popup slots into that pattern rather than adding a retained-overlay system; host owns scrim, open/close, Esc/outside-click and overlay-bleed gating (hub menuKeepsWorld / TQ-88).

nodes.label: Account hardening (mirror-overwrite guard, credential dedup, header-only session)
nodes.norm_label: account hardening (mirror-overwrite guard, credential dedup, header-only session)
nodes.rationale: A stale/empty server read can't wipe a good local list; a flush race can't mint a duplicate account; the session token never travels via URL.

nodes.label: Cloud saves per account
nodes.rationale: A logged-in account owns its characters on the server (store.js account model + account.js /account/characters CRUD gated by an account session token) so they follow the account across devices; first login migrates the current save as the first cloud character; stale sessions sign out cleanly.

nodes.label: _design-tour.mjs screenshot harness
nodes.rationale: Playwright tour via window.tqGo at desktop 1280x800 + portrait 430x880; must inject animation:none and hide the [data-tq=html-monsters] overlay or live monster DOM churn hangs Playwright screenshots.

nodes.label: Prod ops runbooks (reseed-*, wipe-reseed-prod, topup-monsters-prod, verify-prod*, gen-batch-prod)
nodes.norm_label: prod ops runbooks (reseed-*, wipe-reseed-prod, topup-monsters-prod, verify-prod*, gen-batch-prod)

nodes.label: ?ws= WS override + solo-round server env
nodes.rationale: Point a dev-served client at any WS server without rebuilding dist; MATCH_MIN_PLAYERS=1 MATCH_COUNTDOWN_S=0 gives solo instant rounds, ENCOUNTER_RADIUS=50000 forces a fast wild encounter.

nodes.label: Game Design Polish 5-Pass Tracking
nodes.rationale: Final verdict: UI is mature; a 5-lens audit found exactly 2 defects (profile portrait crowding: stat-label and team-row), both fixed. Live overworld/combat capture deferred because a solo run can auto-enter paid AI combat.

nodes.label: Visual-QA harness suite (tools/)
nodes.rationale: Headless Playwright harnesses screenshot canvas scenes into .screenshots/ because unit tests can't catch layout/colour/overlap regressions on a canvas.

nodes.label: Deploy-every-change-ASAP policy
nodes.rationale: Production (tamersquest.com, Railway, auto-deploys from master) IS the test environment; commit + git push to master after every landed change immediately, but build must pass first because a broken bundle takes the site down.

nodes.label: Live combat capture deferred (paid AI cost)
nodes.norm_label: live combat capture deferred (paid ai cost)
nodes.rationale: Needs full local stack (WS :8080 + vite dev) and the DEV __net handshake; a solo run can trigger AI combat that costs real money, so not run autonomously without Dominik's OK. Overworld HUD geometry already verified via the hub capture, which draws identical geometry.

nodes.label: Verify-before-acting (screenshots can mislead)
nodes.rationale: Low-opacity text and mid-animation frames produce false positives (the title .version looked garbled but the code is one clean element); always confirm against source before editing.

nodes.label: Production is the test environment
nodes.rationale: Run npm run build before pushing; commit small changes directly to master; log failing tests in docs/BUGFIX_LOG.md instead of blocking production test deploys.

nodes.label: Never run MP harnesses against prod
nodes.norm_label: never run mp harnesses against prod
nodes.rationale: They join/queue and would inject test traffic into the live game; SP-only / menu captures and tqGo station tours are read-only and safe.

nodes.label: Deep Vault upgrade (+25 vault cap/level)
nodes.rationale: Costs 100->160->256->410->655 (x1.6/lvl), total 1581; Prospector + Deep Vault = 4266 gold to max both, ~20-30 runs.

nodes.label: Essence (premium, Paddle, never earned)
nodes.rationale: Non-pay-to-win hard constraint: essence buys cosmetics only, never power, is never earned in runs; the old Attunement upgrade line was removed (TQ-132).

nodes.label: Gold (only earned currency)
nodes.rationale: Decision TQ-92 (Dominik): accept the current pace as the design. Sources: 4 + 2*monsterLevel per defeat, +30 extract bonus, both scaled by Prospector. Typical run ~142 gold. Per-defeat gold credited live so failed runs never yield zero.

nodes.label: Player-account prestige level (TQ-186)
nodes.rationale: Decision TQ-176: build it. Earned from play, server-authoritative, confers no power (prestige number only). 2 + 1*lvl per defeat, 25 per extract, same xpForLevel curve, so accounts level much slower than monsters — a long climb. Constants in GAME.PLAYER_XP.

nodes.label: Prospector upgrade (+20% gold/level, max L5)
nodes.rationale: Costs 120->216->389->700->1260 (x1.8/lvl), total 2685; L1 costs <1 run for immediate positive feedback.

nodes.label: PARITY-3 inventory engine (addCaughtMonster, applyRoster, equipChain, nextChainId)
nodes.norm_label: parity-3 inventory engine (addcaughtmonster, applyroster, equipchain, nextchainid)
nodes.rationale: The catch rule was inlined identically in MP world.js and SP fight.js; applyRoster moved out of world.js into the engine and re-exported; nextChainId replaced byte-identical cycleChain in both scenes.

nodes.label: Geometric sinks vs capped earn multiplier
nodes.norm_label: geometric sinks vs capped earn multiplier
nodes.rationale: Sink costs grow x1.8/x1.6 per level while the earn-rate multiplier is hard-capped at x2.0, so each upgrade level stays meaningfully expensive.

nodes.label: Non-pay-to-win invariant
nodes.rationale: All power sinks (upgrades, chains) are gold-only; the earn economy is kept fully separate from the paid one. Tuning must preserve: power is gold-only and runs-to-max stays ~20-50.

nodes.label: One resolver per concern (combat, mapgen, rewards, storm, movement, roster, inventory)
nodes.norm_label: one resolver per concern (combat, mapgen, rewards, storm, movement, roster, inventory)
nodes.rationale: All game rules live in src/engine/* and server/*; no combat math, mapgen, inventory, movement physics, economy or collision in a scene.

nodes.norm_label: ai floor tiles — generate & browse panel

nodes.norm_label: asset generation tab (monsters / items / biomes / tiles sub-tabs)

nodes.norm_label: generation hub — test generation (dry run, explicit save to pool)
nodes.rationale: TQ-213/214/216: generating and saving were split into preview (/api/admin/gen/test, no pool write) and an explicit Save to pool (/api/admin/gen/save). TQ-347 removed the old one-click generate-AND-save button for monsters.

nodes.rationale: DOM mirror of in-game src/ui/monsterDetail.js; computes Lv.1→Lv.50 stats inline with the same calcStat formula as src/engine/stats.js; exposed as window.__openMonsterCard QA hook.

nodes.rationale: One spec per asset type renders (1) a flow diagram showing what each phase collects/propagates and (2) an expandable section per phase with model/temperature, system+user prompts, emitted-schema view and field descriptions. Textareas reuse the same data-key classes (prompt-field / sd-field / ov) the load/save paths use, so it is purely a re-layout.

nodes.rationale: 6 unused vars left on purpose (P-object destructure contract, hot-path usingVec, elision-only destructure siblings), 20 internal-only exports, 2 dead _reset*Cache hooks, the mt param in gamedata.js genAttackMove, and possibly-dead exports like monsterDetail.js isInsidePanel and keybinds.js API.

nodes.norm_label: five pass orderings (a-z, z-a, loc desc, loc asc, subsystem)

nodes.norm_label: two-column admin layout (tq-210/346: inputs left, outputs right)
nodes.rationale: At ≥980px the Monsters gen pane splits configuration INPUTS (settings/prompts/schema) left and generation OUTPUTS (preview/trace/list) right; output panes are fixed-height and scroll internally so the layout stays stable.

nodes.label: Codebase Cleanup 5-Pass Tracking
nodes.rationale: Dominik /loop directive: clean file by file, line by line, 5 passes each in a different order. Varied ordering + technique beats repeating one method 5x: A->Z and Z->A full reads caught different dead imports, static no-unused-vars sweep found 7 more, export audit proved the surface clean.

nodes.label: Conservative behavior-preserving cleanup rules
nodes.rationale: No feature changes; each batch must pass lint+test+build; commit by explicit pathspec (never git add -A) because of a shared tree with concurrent agents; contested files (hub.js, tiles.js, onlineGame.js, world.js) committed alone.

nodes.label: Cross-file export audit (192 exports)
nodes.rationale: 170 exports consumed externally; 20 internal-only (redundant export keyword, left since removal is cosmetic and risks a missed dynamic consumer); 2 dead _reset*Cache test hooks left because they follow the repo's test-isolation convention. Net 0 removals.

nodes.label: One-off eslint no-unused-vars sweep
nodes.rationale: The repo lint gate is no-undef only, so unused vars/imports slip through; an order-independent whole-codebase sweep covers 'largest first' comprehensively and the largest files held the most dead code.

nodes.label: HUD outside the square play window (HUD-OUT)
nodes.norm_label: hud outside the square play window (hud-out)
nodes.rationale: User priority: the world shows ONLY inside the centered square; periphery becomes opaque HUD gutters housing minimap, team overview, chain HUD, timer, objective, biome chip and touch controls via shared render/hudLayout.js + playWindowLayout.

nodes.label: Back-button two-family rule
nodes.rationale: Identity pages (profile/friends/settings) use centered title + top-left Back; hub stations (shop/bestiary) use left title + top-right Back. Deliberate, not a bug.

nodes.label: Design guardrails (Dominik's settled decisions)
nodes.rationale: Flat themed UI via theme.js tokens; tile cross-fade WANTED (TQ-449/483); back-button two-family split by design; drawMonsterIcon fit only in icon/inventory; no desktop mouse-walk; square play window + portrait HUD gutters intentional; buttons via addButton/drawButton, combat buttons hand-rolled.

nodes.label: Profile portrait crowding fixes
nodes.rationale: 7-column stat row label scale cellW*0.24/cap12 left no gap -> tightened to cellW*0.19/cap11; team-row ' L{level}' suffix was appended after name truncation -> reserved ~4 chars. Both in profile.js + profilePanel.js.

nodes.label: AI-generated combat items (use instead of attack/flee)
nodes.norm_label: ai-generated combat items (use instead of attack/flee)
nodes.rationale: Items are simple (name + short action description), AI-generated via genItems.js, stored in profile.items, dropped from chests (~30%), only usable during combat where the v2 judge assesses them like an attack; item use replaces the player's attack and the item is consumed.

nodes.label: combatMaxTurnDamageFrac variance clamp
nodes.rationale: Admin-tunable cap on a single AI turn's HP loss as a fraction of max HP; defaults to 1 (off).

nodes.label: Structured Fight-Judgement judge v2 (combatJudgeV2)
nodes.rationale: Structured INPUT = action + full descriptions of both monsters incl. passive/active effects + running fight transcript; structured OUTPUT = per-field EDITS (integers as deltas clamped [0,max], strings as full rewrites, identity locked) + a short display line + a special-actions channel (endBattle/winner/instaWin/flee). Shipped behind an admin flag then made default.

nodes.label: Monster generation v2 multi-agent pipeline (genPipeline)
nodes.rationale: LangChain Idea->Attributes->Model->Review: inspiration agent gives 2-4 words 'to characterize the monster'; designer emits huge structured output incl. 4 attacks (2-3 word title + judge/player-readable description) + visual description; builder agent defines the model with idle + attack animations. All prompts/model settings admin-editable.

nodes.label: PvP hardening (no capture, CSPRNG combat ids, fresh team snapshots)
nodes.norm_label: pvp hardening (no capture, csprng combat ids, fresh team snapshots)
nodes.rationale: Catch rule centralized in onlineGame act() and forged catch rejected server-side; combat ids via store.js secureId (72-bit) so duels can't be enumerated; pvp.js sendToSide includes full team + activeIdx so the action menu never offers a fainted monster's moves.

nodes.label: Field inventory (7 stats in order, abilities ≤4, passive/active, lore)
nodes.norm_label: field inventory (7 stats in order, abilities ≤4, passive/active, lore)
nodes.rationale: Stats key order: health, strength, defense, speed, power, energy, luck. Any ability field may be absent on AI-authored monsters — render only present fields, never undefined/NaN.

nodes.label: Gen stages are LangChain-backed (reverted wrong edit)
nodes.norm_label: gen stages are langchain-backed (reverted wrong edit)
nodes.rationale: An agent changed a genPipeline.js comment to 'openai.js-backed' but genStages.js dynamic-imports @langchain/openai; the original comment was correct and the edit was reverted.

nodes.label: No run-start auto-heal + free lobby Healer
nodes.norm_label: no run-start auto-heal + free lobby healer
nodes.rationale: User: teams never auto-heal; an injured team carries damage into the next run; a free Healer station in the lobby (server heal message, idle-only) heals to full; extract-victory heal kept as an earned reward.

nodes.label: genAttacks as a monster's combat moves
nodes.norm_label: genattacks as a monster's combat moves
nodes.rationale: genAttacks have no numeric fields, so offering them in combat was gated on making the descriptive v2 judge the default; getAttacksForMonster prefers genAttacks, the crash-net synthesizes a neutral profile.

nodes.label: Rotation reload fix (RENDER_SCALE cap < 4096)
nodes.rationale: Loading in portrait froze a large RENDER_SCALE; rotating to landscape produced a 5474px-wide canvas over GPU MAX_TEXTURE_SIZE -> WebGL context loss -> Safari reload to title. Fix caps RENDER_SCALE so the buffer's longest side stays <4096 in either orientation.

nodes.label: Status effects: real mechanics, per-fight, judge-only
nodes.norm_label: status effects: real mechanics, per-fight, judge-only
nodes.rationale: Combat prompt defines DoT (Burn/Poison/Bleed), turn-loss (Stun/Freeze/Sleep), damage-down (Weaken) and forbids cosmetic statuses; status is cleared when a fight ends (MP endCombat, PvP endPvp, SP) and only changed by the in-fight judge.

nodes.label: Client-side movement prediction + reconciliation
nodes.rationale: Predict own movement with the same rule as the server (BASE_SPEED x sprint, diagonals x0.707, body-edge collision via shared isWalkable in mapgen.js); error-proportional reconciliation, hard snap on >220px jump.

nodes.label: Client→server messages (join, queue, unqueue, input, combatAction, ping)
nodes.norm_label: client→server messages (join, queue, unqueue, input, combataction, ping)
nodes.rationale: No leave/interact/swap message: leaving is a socket close, extraction/encounters are proximity-triggered server-side.

nodes.label: Open questions Q10-Q13 + binary encoding
nodes.rationale: Q10 death penalty (lose active team, vault safe), Q11 PvP design, Q12 reconnection grace, Q13 AoI-filter players like monsters.

nodes.label: Server→client messages (welcome, queued, matchFound, roundStart, snapshot, combat*, extracted, died, pong, error)
nodes.norm_label: server→client messages (welcome, queued, matchfound, roundstart, snapshot, combat*, extracted, died, pong, error)

nodes.label: Snapshot message + area-of-interest filtering
nodes.rationale: Per-viewer; carries tick, roundId, you{id,x,y,ack,team[{hp,max}]}, nearby players, visible monsters, time, circle, portals. Monsters AoI-filtered within AOI_RADIUS 900px, hidden ones reveal within REVEAL_RADIUS 220px; players sent to everyone (open Q13). Doc states 15Hz tick / snapshots every other tick (stale: sim default is now 30Hz).

nodes.label: WebSocket JSON envelope {t, ...}
nodes.rationale: One persistent same-origin wss connection; client->server and server->client types are disjoint; binary encoding is a future option if snapshot bandwidth is a problem at 16 players.

nodes.label: Death keeps per-defeat gold, forfeits extract bonus
nodes.norm_label: death keeps per-defeat gold, forfeits extract bonus
nodes.rationale: Defeat loses the active run team (Q10) but gold already credited live is kept; only the +30 extract bonus is forfeited, so extraction is the reward for surviving and no run yields zero.

nodes.label: Rival velocity extrapolation smoothing
nodes.rationale: Chosen over sending snapshots more often (no extra bandwidth): velocity estimated from successive snapshot deltas, clamped to ~1.7x sprint as teleport guard, zeroed when a rival stops.

nodes.label: Server-authoritative game
nodes.rationale: Clients send input and render snapshots; trusted state, movement, combat, loot and persistence belong on the server or shared engine code.

nodes.label: Authority model (clients send intents, server validates)
nodes.norm_label: authority model (clients send intents, server validates)
nodes.rationale: Anti-cheat: movement is direction-only (server integrates at GAME.BASE_SPEED, clamps axis to [-1,1] NaN-safe, normalizes diagonals, tile collision + bounds); combatAction honors only the active monster's own attacks; a client only acts on its own combat session.

nodes.label: Interpolation-only client (prediction deferred at doc time)
nodes.norm_label: interpolation-only client (prediction deferred at doc time)
nodes.rationale: seq/ack plumbing exists; full prediction/reconciliation deferred because interpolation was smooth and drift-free (later shipped per the archive).

nodes.label: First-login username prompt (OAuth ?new=1)
nodes.rationale: User request 2026-06-10: brand-new Google/Discord accounts pick a visible name instead of being auto-named from email; POSTs to /account/username with x-account-session header.

nodes.label: Forgot password (TQ-59)
nodes.rationale: Neutral reply never reveals whether the email has an account (no enumeration); server always 200s.

nodes.label: OAuth login (Google / Discord)
nodes.rationale: Buttons redirect to /auth/google or /auth/discord; the server returns /?token=…&acct=…[&new=1] or /?login=failed|unavailable. Token is scrubbed from history via replaceState.

nodes.label: Password reset landing (/?reset=token)
nodes.rationale: Emailed single-use token lands here; POSTs {token,password} to /auth/reset-password; min 8 chars; token scrubbed from URL.

nodes.label: Provider availability probe (/auth/providers)
nodes.rationale: Server only enables an OAuth provider when client id+secret are in env; probing up front marks an unconfigured provider 'soon' instead of failing after a redirect. Fail-open if the probe fails.

nodes.label: Tamer's Account email/password sign-in/sign-up
nodes.rationale: AUTH-T3 native account: POSTs {email,password[,nickname]} to /auth/login or /auth/signup; a brand-new account returns an accountSession with NO token (no characters yet), which the client accepts.

nodes.label: ALLOWED_ORIGINS allow-list
nodes.rationale: Governs WS verifyClient AND the AI-cost /api/combat/* CORS; empty = allow-all (combined deploy only). Global connection cap (createConnLimiter) remains the safe fallback regardless of origin.

nodes.label: Required Railway env vars
nodes.rationale: OPENAI_API_KEY (AI judge + generation; without it combat falls to deterministic crash-net), DATABASE_URL (Postgres; else in-memory), Google/Discord OAuth, ADMIN_TOKEN (/admin + /api/admin/*), PUBLIC_ORIGIN.

nodes.label: Account security audit fixes
nodes.rationale: OAuth email trusted only when provider-verified; /auth/:provider per-IP rate-limited; clientIp reads the trusted RIGHTMOST x-forwarded-for hop (TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS); login-attempt + CSRF maps size-bounded. Deferred: state not browser-bound (needs state-cookie/PKCE).

nodes.label: Per-IP connection cap (CONN_MAX_PER_IP)
nodes.rationale: Default 40, keyed on trusted clientIp, generous so shared NAT/CGNAT isn't blocked; sits on top of the global cap in createConnLimiter.

nodes.label: Login system review + 3 shipped gaps (username prompt, login indicator, profile page)
nodes.norm_label: login system review + 3 shipped gaps (username prompt, login indicator, profile page)
nodes.rationale: Sign-in flow judged sound (CSRF-protected, rate-limited, email-verified-only, no token-in-URL). Indicator lives only on character select; native email signups still default name to the email handle.

nodes.label: Optional ops (rotate secrets, ALLOWED_ORIGINS, imprint contact)
nodes.norm_label: optional ops (rotate secrets, allowed_origins, imprint contact)

nodes.label: Combined deploy (one Node process serves dist + WS)
nodes.norm_label: combined deploy (one node process serves dist + ws)
nodes.rationale: Railway NIXPACKS build, startCommand npm run start = vite build then node server/index.js; server serves dist/ and accepts WS upgrades on the same PORT (default 8080); same-origin WS means no client config.

nodes.label: Split deploy (static client CDN + WS-only game service)
nodes.norm_label: split deploy (static client cdn + ws-only game service)
nodes.rationale: Tested config path for scaling the game server independently: SERVE_STATIC=false, ALLOWED_ORIGINS allow-list, PUBLIC_ORIGIN; client built with VITE_SERVER_URL. Keep combined deploy for now.

nodes.label: Password reset / native-account email (DEFERRED by user)
nodes.norm_label: password reset / native-account email (deferred by user)
nodes.rationale: User 2026-06-09: 'defer the setup of the native account system and email, I will get back to this later.' Needs an SMTP/transactional-email provider + env key the user will supply; only email-dependent flows are parked, native login/sign-up is live.

nodes.label: Email/SMTP provider needed for password reset
nodes.norm_label: email/smtp provider needed for password reset
nodes.rationale: The reset flow (generate -> email link -> consume -> set password) can't be finished without a way to send the link; blocked on the user picking Resend/Postmark/SES/SMTP and adding env on Railway.

nodes.label: Admin settings stay current
nodes.rationale: Any new live gameplay knob, AI prompt, model setting or generated asset type useful for live tuning is surfaced in admin.

nodes.label: Guests are session-only
nodes.rationale: Guests keep no saved characters (clearGuestCharacters on boot) so only logged-in players have save files.

nodes.label: Clean wipe + pure-AI roster (AI_MONSTERS_ONLY)
nodes.rationale: Prod DB wiped (16 profiles + old generated monsters, irreversible); 5 fresh AI monsters + 5 items. The 115 hand-authored base monsters live in code not the DB, so prod loads zero seed monsters by default; set AI_MONSTERS_ONLY=0 to bring them back. Initial 5 were very dark-themed.

nodes.label: Ember-on-Charcoal Brand Palette (#F0533D / #FFB199 rim on #14110F-#050505 base)
nodes.norm_label: ember-on-charcoal brand palette (#f0533d / #ffb199 rim on #14110f-#050505 base)

nodes.label: Hooded Spirit-Tamer Mascot (shadowed face, glowing ember eyes)
nodes.norm_label: hooded spirit-tamer mascot (shadowed face, glowing ember eyes)

nodes.label: Spirit-Chain Ring Brand Mark (8-bead ember ring)
nodes.norm_label: spirit-chain ring brand mark (8-bead ember ring)

nodes.label: PWA Icon 192 (hooded spirit-tamer, ember on charcoal)
nodes.norm_label: pwa icon 192 (hooded spirit-tamer, ember on charcoal)

nodes.label: PWA Icon 512 (hooded spirit-tamer, ember on charcoal)
nodes.norm_label: pwa icon 512 (hooded spirit-tamer, ember on charcoal)

nodes.label: Maskable Safe-Zone Layout (full-bleed backdrop, centered subject)
nodes.norm_label: maskable safe-zone layout (full-bleed backdrop, centered subject)

nodes.label: TQ-380: favicon synced to in-game brand (theme.js PAL), teal-green dropped for ember
nodes.norm_label: tq-380: favicon synced to in-game brand (theme.js pal), teal-green dropped for ember

nodes.label: Standardized Monster-Detail Popup spec (TQ-122)
nodes.rationale: ONE component renders identity + vitals + stats + abilities + description identically from bestiary, roster, hub and combat (TQ-123 builds, TQ-124/125 wire). Read-only; catching/field/release actions stay owned by the caller as optional buttons.

nodes.label: Caller-computed live vitals contract
nodes.rationale: The caller computes vitals so the popup shows HP/energy matching the surface it opened from (roster full bars, combat live net.state.combat) and the popup never re-derives state; XP omitted mid-fight.

nodes.label: No internal scrolling — measure-then-drop
nodes.rationale: The kaboom shim has no clip/scissor (TQ-126), so the popup must fit its rect by truncation; drop order on short viewports: lore first, then ability descriptions, then trailing abilities — mirroring the hub modal's overflow guard.

nodes.label: Visual tokens reuse (elementColor neutral, RARITY_COLOR, drawPanel, drawButton, hpColor)
nodes.norm_label: visual tokens reuse (elementcolor neutral, rarity_color, drawpanel, drawbutton, hpcolor)
nodes.rationale: No per-element colour because elements are free-form/AI-invented (elementColor returns the neutral accent); rarity reuses the same RARITY_COLOR tiers as the item bag (TQ-64).
